articles.summary: Starting January 1, 2027, the way pregnancy care is billed to insurance changes across the country. The care does not change. The paperwork behind it does. Here is what patients are likely to notice, in plain language, plus a short script for the front desk staff who are about to start getting these questions.
articles.title: Your pregnancy bill is changing in January. Here is what it means.
